verdict.rationale: Greptile itself functions as an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to — running reviews (greptile-docs-14), generating tests (greptile-docs-18), fixing issues via 'Fix with your Agent'/'Fix All' (greptile-docs-2,3), running sandboxed dynamic analysis (greptile-docs-19), and answering codebase questions (greptile-comm-1 shows a real Q&A delegation). However, independent community reports document reliability problems when actually delegating tasks (incomplete/incorrect template analysis, internal errors, stuck processing) that temper confidence in the assistant working consistently. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the newer delegated capabilities (test generation, TREX, Fix All) beyond vendor docs, and resolution of the reliability complaints from community reports.
